summary: Iteration 2 – Chat feature (AI + admin↔customer support). CRITICAL frontend bug found & fixed: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts had a malformed api object (closed early with `};` then orphan lines) that omitted all chat methods; without this fix the whole chat feature would throw at import/runtime. After fix, all 16 backend chat tests pass and full customer+admin UI flow verified end-to-end via mobile viewport.
action_items: None – all listed feature requirements verified passing. Main agent can proceed to next feature or ship.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts was malformed (missing chat methods, orphan lines). Now fixed with chatAi, chatAiHistory, supportSend, supportMy, supportConversations, supportConversation.

chat_ai endpoint recreates LlmChat per request without replaying stored history to the model (comment acknowledges). Multi-turn context relies solely on per-request session; if long conversation memory is required, replay last N messages into LlmChat. Not a bug for MVP.
Support polling every 5s on customer chat and 4s on admin detail is acceptable; consider WebSocket later.
Empty state, mobile spacing (8pt grid), 44px touch targets, and Vietnamese copy look correct in screenshots.

rca_of_issue: RCA: A prior edit to /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts left the `api = { ... };` object closed prematurely with lines 148-152 dangling outside it (line 148 started with `: () => request<SupportMessage[]>(...)` – an orphan property without a key). This produced (a) TypeScript/parse errors, (b) missing api.chatAi/chatAiHistory/supportSend/supportMy/supportConversations/supportConversation. Repro: open /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx which calls api.chatAiHistory() – module would fail. Fix: rewrote the tail of api.ts to place all six chat methods inside the api object before the closing `};`.
